title: Text: DET Ron Colangelo ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Hi Anthony, Tigerfest is sold out. We actually sold more tickets than last year. Nice story on the D Thanks, Ron
I’ll put that out there. Thank you
BTW- Gardenhire to sell first ticket at box office on Saturday
Single-game tickets go on sale 9 am Saturday, if I recall correctly
Would be good to remind the Freep.com audience of that
Man, Sipple's story was something you'd see posted on Bless You Boys...
The same Bless You Boys featured on the Tigers Player Development clips?
Hardly featured... we monitor to make sure they aren't posting inaccurate information.
Beat reporters don't randomly tweet that the "team is terrible any way." If he doesn't like the beat, go cover roller derby
George is passionate about the Tigers’ heritage and tradition
